summary.text: Denise Tepler is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 24, seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She took office in the Senate on December 3, 2024, after serving in the Maine House of Representatives from 2014 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Denise Tepler's career experience includes serving as a board member and president of Emerge Maine and working as a small business owner.
She previously served on the M.S.A.D. #75 school board.
Tepler represented House District 54 from 2014 to 2022, and in the 2019–2020 and 2021–2022 sessions she chaired the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee.
In the 2025–2026 Senate session she chairs the Environment and Natural Resources Committee and the Marine Resources Committee and also serves on the Senatorial Vote Committee.
